Proof-of-concept build. Install the APK, open **Codeswitch Voice (POC)**, and download the model (about 660 MB, once).

- Model: v3 fine-tune (run `r3-en30`) of Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2, sherpa-onnx int8, pinned to HF revision `92679110e821`.
- Model card: https://huggingface.co/danielrosehill/Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-v2-English-Hebrew-Codeswitching
- arm64-v8a only. Android 9+.
- Recommended with HeliBoard as your main keyboard. Its mic key opens this voice IME.
